description: Atelier Ten describes using IESVE for more than ten Green Mark projects in Singapore. The narrative includes Mandai Eco-resort, where simulations assessed facade strategies, a chilled-water system and passive cooling in the Treehouse Suites. Baseline and proposed designs were compared to assess energy-conservation measures. The provider reports an energy improvement exceeding 30% against the reference model for that example. The reported improvement is a model comparison. It does not establish measured operational savings. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
